mn70:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā kāsīsu cārikaṃ carati mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ.
mn70:2.1: ahaṃ kho bhikkhave aññatreva rattibhojanā bhuñjāmi
mn70:2.2: aññatra kho panāhaṃ bhikkhave rattibhojanā bhuñjamāno appābādhatañca sañjānāmi appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañca
mn70:2.3: etha tumhepi bhikkhave aññatreva rattibhojanā bhuñjatha
mn70:2.4: aññatra kho pana bhikkhave tumhepi rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañcāti.
mn70:2.5: evaṃ bhanteti kho te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn70:3.1: atha kho bhagavā kāsīsu anupubbena cārikaṃ caramāno yena kīṭāgiri nāma kāsīnaṃ nigamo tadavasari.
mn70:3.2: tatra sudaṃ bhagavā kīṭāgirismiṃ viharati kāsīnaṃ nigame.
mn70:4.1: tena kho pana samayena assaji punabbasukā nāma bhikkhū kīṭāgirismiṃ āvāsikā honti.
mn70:4.2: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū yena assaji punabbasukā bhikkhū tenupasaṅkamiṃsu upasaṅkamitvā assaji punabbasuke bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
mn70:4.3: bhagavā kho āvuso aññatreva rattibhojanā bhuñjati bhikkhusaṅgho ca
mn70:4.4: aññatra kho panāvuso rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañca sañjānanti appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañca
mn70:4.5: etha tumhepi āvuso aññatreva rattibhojanā bhuñjatha
mn70:4.6: aññatra kho panāvuso tumhepi rattibhojanā bhuñjamānā appābādhatañca sañjānissatha appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañcāti.
mn70:4.7: evaṃ vutte assajipunabbasukā bhikkhū te bhikkhū etadavocuṃ
mn70:4.8: mayaṃ kho āvuso sāyañceva bhuñjāma pāto ca divā ca vikāle
mn70:4.9: te mayaṃ sāyañceva bhuñjamānā pāto ca divā ca vikāle appābādhatañca sañjānāma appātaṅkatañca lahuṭṭhānañca balañca phāsuvihārañca
mn70:4.10: te mayaṃ kiṃ sandiṭṭhikaṃ hitvā kālikaṃ anudhāvissāma
mn70:4.11: sāyañceva mayaṃ bhuñjissāma pāto ca divā ca vikāleti.

mn70:13.4: yassatthāya kulaputtā sammadeva agārasmā anagāriyaṃ pabbajanti tadanuttaraṃ brahmacariyapariyosānaṃ diṭṭheva dhamme sayaṃ abhiññā sacchikatvā upasampajja vihareyyunti.
mn70:13.5: imaṃ kho ahaṃ bhikkhave imesaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ appamādaphalaṃ sampassamāno appamādena karaṇīyanti vadāmi.

mn70:23.2: idha bhikkhave saddhājāto upasaṅkamati upasaṅkamanto payirupāsati payirupāsanto sotaṃ odahati ohitasoto dhammaṃ suṇāti sutvā dhammaṃ dhāreti dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhati atthaṃ upaparikkhato dhammā nijjhānaṃ khamanti dhammanijjhānakkhantiyā sati chando jāyati chandajāto ussahati ussahitvā tuleti tulayitvā padahati pahitatto samāno kāyena ceva paramaṃ saccaṃ sacchikaroti paññāya ca naṃ ativijjha passati.
mn70:24.14: kīvadūrevime bhikkhave moghapurisā apakkantā imasmā dhammavinayā.
mn70:25.1: atthi bhikkhave catuppadaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ yassuddiṭṭhassa viññū puriso nacirasseva paññāya atthaṃ ājāneyya
mn70:25.3: ke ca mayaṃ bhante ke ca dhammassa aññātāroti.
mn70:26.1: yopi so bhikkhave satthā āmisagaruko āmisadāyādo āmisehi saṃsaṭṭho viharati tassapāyaṃ evarūpī paṇo paṇaviyā na upeti
mn70:26.2: evañca no assa atha naṃ kareyyāma na ca no evamassa na naṃ kareyyāmāti. kimpana bhikkhave yaṃ tathāgato sabbaso āmisehi visaṃsaṭṭho viharati
mn70:27.1: saddhassa bhikkhave sāvakassa satthu sāsane pariyogayhaṃ vattato ayamanudhammo hoti
mn70:27.4: saddhassa bhikkhave sāvakassa satthu sāsane pariyogayha vattato rūḷhanīyaṃ satthu sāsanaṃ hoti ojavantaṃ.
mn70:27.5: saddhassa bhikkhave sāvakassa satthu sāsane pariyogayha vattato ayamanudhammo hoti
mn70:27.6: kāmaṃ taco ca nahāru ca aṭṭhi ca avasussatu me sarīre avasussatu maṃsalohitaṃ yantaṃ purisathāmena purisaviriyena purisaparakkamena pattabbaṃ na taṃ apāpuṇitvā viriyassa santhānaṃ bhavissatīti.
mn70:27.7: saddhassa bhikkhave sāvakassa satthu sāsane pariyogayha vattato dvinnaṃ phalānaṃ aññataraṃ phalaṃ pāṭikaṅkhaṃ
mn70:27.8: diṭṭheva dhamme aññā sati vā upādisese anāgāmitāti.
mn70:27.10: attamanā te bhikkhū bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandunti.
